# self_alias_column

<!-- Generated by xtask. Do not edit by hand. -->

**Summary:** Removes column aliases that repeat the source name.

**Default level:** `warn`

**Fixable:** yes

## Rationale

Self-aliases add noise without changing query semantics.

## Configuration

```toml
[lints]
self_alias_column = { level = "warn" }
```

### Options

No options.

## Notes

- The current implementation only flags exact same-name aliases.

## Examples

**Anti-pattern:**

```sql
SELECT customer_id AS customer_id FROM orders
```

**Best practice:**

```sql
SELECT customer_id FROM orders
```
